macro.notes: FOMC: d is the statement day; every statement page was fetched and the range cross-checked against the Fed open market table (which lists the effective date, one day later). 2020-03-03 and 2020-03-15 were unscheduled meetings (the Fed historical page labels the first 'March 2'; the statement is dated March 3); the scheduled 17-18 March 2020 meeting was cancelled; notation votes without a rate change (19, 23, 31 March 2020; 27 Aug 2020; 22 Aug 2025) are omitted. 2027 FOMC dates are tentative per the Fed. CPI/jobs: actual dates from the BLS release archives through the August 2026 reference month; 2026-10-14, 2026-11-10, 2026-12-10 (CPI) and 2026-10-02, 2026-11-06, 2026-12-04 (jobs) are scheduled dates from the BLS schedule pages; the 2026-10-02 jobs release was scheduled but not yet seen in the BLS archive when checked. BLS has not published a 2027 schedule (bls.gov/schedule/2027/home.htm returned 404). 2025 shutdown: October 2025 CPI and October 2025 Employment Situation releases were not published; September 2025 CPI came 2025-10-24, November 2025 CPI 2025-12-18, September 2025 jobs 2025-11-20, November 2025 jobs 2025-12-16; there was no CPI release in November 2025 and no jobs release in October 2025. GDP: advance-estimate dates from the BEA news archive; 2025-12-23 is the Q3 2025 'initial estimate' that replaced the advance estimate after the shutdown; 2026-10-29 is scheduled (Q3 2026); BEA has not published 2027 dates.
